Offline Story Puzzle

Book Spirit Repair

Restore scattered story fragments, unlock enchanted chapters, and wake the spirit hidden inside an old library.

Book Spirit Repair is a single-player iPhone puzzle game about arranging short page fragments into the correct story order. Each restored chapter unlocks the next, keeping progress private and local on your device.

Main Menu

Enter the enchanted library and begin restoring scattered book chapters.

Chapter Start

Read the mixed story fragments and decide how the chapter should unfold.

Page Repair

Tap two page fragments to swap them, then verify the restored order.

Helpful Controls

Use guidance and pause controls while keeping progress local on device.

Features

Story-order puzzles

Read four page fragments and arrange them from beginning to discovery, repair, and ending.

Chapter unlocks

Only chapter 1 is open at first. Restoring a chapter unlocks the next one.

Tap-to-swap controls

Select one fragment, tap another, and verify when the chapter reads correctly.

Enchanted library style

Warm parchment, old books, and magical repair effects frame each puzzle.

Quick offline sessions

Designed for short, calm play without internet, accounts, or purchases.

Private by design

No ads, analytics, tracking, login, or personal data collection.

About Book Spirit Repair

In Book Spirit Repair, every chapter is a tiny tale that has fallen out of order. The challenge is not speed or noise, but careful reading: find the first moment, follow the clue, complete the repair, and reveal the ending.

The game stores unlocked chapters and settings locally on your device. It is built as a quiet offline puzzle experience for all ages.

Support

How do I play?

Tap one page fragment, then tap another to swap them. Press Verify when the story order feels correct.

How do chapters unlock?

Chapter 1 is available by default. Completing each chapter unlocks the next chapter.

Need help?

After release, contact support through the App Store product page.
